rv.q: This magic moment, this ultimate accolade happened again last Sunday at the close of THE LIGHT.
Fleetwood-Jourdain Theatre’s current revival of The Light, directed by Tim Rhoze, shows Webb’s taut and empathetic two-character play retains the power of the original production.
Their performances pull out all the stops.
This play is perfect for those interested in intimate stories with small casts that touch on socio-political topics in nuanced and complex ways.
All in all, this intimate and forceful presentation is a must see!

cn.t: Webb's powerful two-hander earns acclaim for its taut examination of a Black couple's relationship unraveling over difficult revelations, with strong performances navigating emotionally demanding material.
